title: DECONSTRUCTING SELF-BIAS IN LLM-GENERATED TRANSLATION BENCHMARKS

bias_targets.methodology: Quantified as the difference between a model's evaluation (or ranking) of its own generated translation outputs and the mean evaluations assigned to those same outputs by other peer models.

Assessed by comparing the translation quality (using MetricX-QE) of source texts generated in isolation versus those co-generated with reference translations, to reveal if models generate texts tailored to their specific translation strengths.

Evaluated by measuring within-model and cross-model textual similarity using chrF@K scores and Type-Token Ratio (TTR) to show that models tend to generate homogeneous source texts conforming to their own specific linguistic patterns.
